After a first half of consolidation, the deadlock was broken early in the second act. In the 53rd minute, Chupete struck for Malaga to level the score at 1-1, signaling the start of a goal-filled afternoon. Fans gathered to witness a match that promised tactical intrigue and high-level competition as the teams fine-tuned their squads for the upcoming season. Daka Ignites the Second Half On August 1, 2026 , the atmosphere intensified as the players took to the pitch. After a competitive first half, the deadlock was broken further into the second period. In the 50th minute, Patson Daka delivered a moment of quality for Hamburger SV , finding the net to level the score at 1-1. The goal injected fresh energy into the home side, who began to press with more conviction and look for a winning opening. Everton responded by tightening their defensive lines, leading to a more physical contest in the middle of the park. The referee was forced to reach for his pocket in the 66th minute, issuing a yellow card to James Tarkowski after a robust challenge. The veteran defender's caution reflected the increasing stakes as both teams pushed for dominance in the closing stages of the match. Last-Gasp Drama in Stoppage Time Just as it appeared the match would end in a stalemate, a dramatic twist occurred deep into injury time. In the 90+4th minute, an unfortunate defensive error led to an own goal by Jordan Torunarigha . The accidental touch sent the ball into the net, handing Everton a late lead that they would not relinquish. It was a heartbreaking conclusion for the hosts, who had fought valiantly throughout the afternoon only to be undone by a final moment of misfortune.
